name: Hidden Enemies
summary: In Orgrimmar, Thrall awaits your report on the Burning Blade. Neeru Fireblade trusts you, and the Warchief needs to know how far the cult's reach extends across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Cult Unveiled
sections.body:
At Warchief Thrall's request, you carried a Lieutenant's Insignia from Skull Rock to Neeru Fireblade. The warlock lives openly in the Cleft of Shadow. Later, you struck at the Searing Blade's leaders deep within Ragefire Chasm.

You posed as a willing recruit and bore the insignias of fallen cultists. That won Fireblade's trust, and he revealed more of the network behind his operations.

sections.title: Whispers of the Shadow Council
sections.body:
Neeru Fireblade believes you are a loyal lieutenant. He admits the loss in Ragefire Chasm has set the Searing Blade back, but the Shadow Council's greater designs remain intact. His masters have active agents in the Barrens and deeper in the forests of Ashenvale.

Your report catches Thrall off guard. The demonic conspiracy reaches far beyond the tunnels beneath Orgrimmar.

sections.title: The Warchief's Vigilance
sections.body:
Thrall chooses caution over executing Neeru at once. If the warlock does not know his cover is compromised, the Horde can monitor his communications and track the cult across Durotar, the Barrens, and Ashenvale.

The Warchief prepares scouts and spies to investigate those branches. He seeks to root out demonic corruption without reckless haste.

faq.q: What is the goal of this quest?
faq.answer: Travel from the Cleft of Shadow to the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar and report to Warchief Thrall. Tell him what Neeru Fireblade disclosed about the Shadow Council's plans.

faq.q: Why does Neeru Fireblade trust me?
faq.answer: You recovered a Lieutenant's Insignia from the Burning Blade at Skull Rock and presented it to Neeru as an ambitious cult initiate. He believes you are a loyal asset.

faq.q: Why doesn't Thrall arrest or execute Neeru Fireblade right away?
faq.answer: Thrall can learn more if Neeru believes his cover remains intact. The Warchief's scouts can monitor his messages and trace his contacts to larger Shadow Council cells across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What new information does Thrall learn from this report?
faq.answer: Thrall learns that the Shadow Council backs the cult beneath Orgrimmar. Its agents are plotting operations in the Barrens and the forests of Ashenvale.

faq.q: Is the Burning Blade the same thing as the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: The Searing Blade is a local sect operating in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. It answers to the wider Burning Blade cult, directed by the demonic Shadow Council.

faq.q: Does this quest chain continue anywhere?
aliases: where does thrall send you next
faq.answer: Thrall tells you to rest and promises to call on you later. No direct continuation of this undercover line follows immediately.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you uncover treason within Orgrimmar's own borders. The young Horde must guard against ancient demonic corruption within while it battles enemies beyond.
As a warlock, you see the danger in Neeru Fireblade's path. Fel practice can slip from sanctioned use into service to the Shadow Council.
As a rogue, you see the Horde's early methods of espionage at work. Deep cover, counterintelligence, and patience take the place of immediate confrontation.
